messages:
alana-cs: Pioneer Legal needs a brief Brazil-region demo next Mon 14:00-15:30 UTC and asked for a temporary peering + allowlist so their lawyers get <300ms p95. renewal marked at-risk if pilot doesn't go well. can we stand this up?
mike-sre: ok. Hosted PAYG? need org id, CIDRs, and requested peak qps. also propose circuit-break thresholds. @ops-oncall FYI.
alana-cs: yes Hosted. org id org-pl-11. CIDRs: 177.91.0.0/24, 177.91.1.0/24. requested peak qps 1,500 (baseline ~180). window 2026-07-06T14:00:00Z->2026-07-06T15:30:00Z. target p95 < 300ms.
rene-platform: we can preference sa-east-1 and add those CIDRs to proxy allowlist. recommend temp max_qps 1600 and circuit_break 2000, plus prewarm KV cache for core prompts. note: Hosted still has multi-region fallback unless we pin via a transient routing policy.
mike-sre: plan: create temp routing pin to sa-east-1, apply allowlist, soft cap 1.6k qps, breaker 2.0k. I'll open the ticket and reserve burst nodes. snippet I'll apply (informal): {org_id:org-pl-11,start:2026-07-06T14:00Z,end:2026-07-06T15:30Z,max_qps:1600,cb_qps:2000,allowlist:["177.91.0.0/24","177.91.1.0/24"]}
infra-bot: ticket #CS-9999 created for temp policy + allowlist. assigned to mike-sre. auto-revoke scheduled.
ops-oncall: capacity confirmed in sa-east-1 for that slot; reserving burst pool. enabling token traces and session dashboard. we'll watch from #release-war-room.
omar-ae: i'll join the demo and renewal call. alan, pls make sure they rotate any long-lived keys and use ephemeral credentials for the session.
alana-cs: will send the prewarm checklist and test prompt set at 13:15 UTC. thanks team :thumbsup: 
mike-sre: policy pushed -> policy_id=tmp-pl-11-20260706. allowlist applied. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-pl-11/session-20260706
ops-oncall: standing by during window; will post 15-min checks and escalate on anomalies.
alana-cs: great  i'll collect post-demo feedback and add notes to the renewal record.
